meta.title: Loading Factors: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Observe or use Loading Factors to apply factors to bids for ranking on a Growth-plan tenant and verify the capability is unavailable.
Repeat the same Loading Factors workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify it is available and works.
Switch or compare tenants by Growth versus Enterprise plan because no tenant identifiers or plan-switching step is provided.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Observe or use Loading Factors to apply factors to bids for ranking on a Growth-plan tenant and verify the capability is unavailable.; Repeat the same Loading Factors workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify it is available and works.; Switch or compare tenants by Growth versus Enterprise plan because no tenant identifiers or plan-switching step is provided.

args.need: sign in to the Growth-plan and Enterprise-plan tenants, try Loading Factors to apply factors to bids for ranking on each, and report whether Growth refuses or omits it while Enterprise allows it

steps.note: The catalog cannot access plan tiers or the Loading Factors workflow, so a tester must perform the cross-plan comparison.
After the tester's comparison, confirm the active screen has no crash or server error; this does not assert Loading Factors behavior.
